name: BellPin
description: BellPin is a 100% offline all-in-one toolkit for students — a dynamic class timetable with period alerts, an attendance tracker with a "Bunk Safe" forecaster, a context-aware lecture recorder with a colorful live waveform, two note types (quick text and hand-drawn pad notes), a blackboard-to-PDF scanner, and a homework tracker with a built-in Pomodoro focus timer. No sign-up, no ads, and no data ever leaves the device unless you turn on the optional Pro Google Drive backup yourself.
features: Dynamic class timetable with automatic period-change alerts
Attendance tracker with a live "Bunk Safe" forecaster
Lecture recorder with a colorful live waveform and background recording
Two note types: quick text notes and hand-drawn pad notes
Scan Blackboard: turn a photo of the board into a PDF
Homework tracker with priorities, due dates, and undo
Recycle Bin with restore for subjects, homework, notes, recordings, and scans
Local Backup & Restore (zip export/import), no account required
First-run onboarding tour explaining every tool
Light / dark / system theme — 100% offline, zero sign-up
Optional BellPin Pro: app-open PIN lock and Google Drive backup/restore
